title: Close conditional strong continuation below one derivative
statement: Assume K=sup_(t<T)E_(7/8) finite. Fractional Sobolev gives ||f_i||_(12/5)<=C_s m_i^(7/8)K. For p=12/5,beta=2-3/p=3/4,pprime=p/(p-1), A_p=(4pi/(3-pprime))^(1/pprime), C_p=(beta+1)beta^[-beta/(beta+1)]A_p^[1/(beta+1)], radius optimization gives potential infinity<=C_p C_s^(4/7)n_i^(3/7)m_i^(1/2)K^(4/7). Convex radial truncation yields M_q(t)<=M_q(0)exp(K_q K^(4/7)t), with explicit K_q=2C_q C_p C_s^(4/7)max_i[m_i^-2 sum_j c_ij n_j^(3/7)m_j^(1/2)]; C_q=q(q-1) for untruncated weight or8q^2 for the truncation family. Holder gives Y7<=C_s^(12/7)(sum m_i^(17/14))K^(12/7)M25(0)^(2/7)exp[(2/7)K25 K^(4/7)t]. Restart the actual weighted-L2 local theory with retained particle numbers and symmetry n_i n_j c_ij. Thus Tstar finite implies unbounded E_(7/8) supremum. More generally THIS direct interpolation needs s>3/4,q>=14s/(4s-3), not merely s>1/2. The missing evolution bound on E_(7/8) is not assumed proved.
